title: Rebecca Dow comments on educational resources and community engagement in recent posts
text:
Rebecca L. Dow, New Mexico State Representative for 38th District (R) | Facebook
Rebecca L. Dow, New Mexico State Representative for 38th District (R) | Facebook
Representative Rebecca Dow, a Republican member of the New Mexico State House representing the 38th district since 2025, recently posted several messages on her social media account addressing educational resources and community engagement.
On August 4, 2025, Dow shared a post expressing agreement with another user, stating "Preach!".
Later that same day, she acknowledged the efforts put into certain educational materials. Dow wrote on August 4, 2025: "Thank you for all your hours investing in these resources! Parents would be wise to take a look! I’ve taught sex ed and this content makes me blush! XXX for sure. @oak4nm @RioGrandeFndn @NMHouseGOP @nmhrcc @NewMexicoGOP @RepBlock @Lord4NM @TheNewMexicoSun".
On August 6, 2025, Dow reflected on her experiences during National Night Out and the role of women in her community. She stated: "You are beautifully and wonderfully made!
Last night was “National Night Out.” I saw so many women who were part of Appletree Educational Center over the decades. Now most are moms and grandmas. Some filling key roles within our community.
I was so aware of how powerful women".
Dow assumed office after being elected in 2025 to replace Tara Jaramillo as state representative for New Mexico's 38th House district.
